messages.en:
{07 00 00}Finding fossils is pretty
hard work! All that digging
takes lots of muscle power.
{07 14 00}But that just makes the
discovery that much
sweeter, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Fossiilide leidmine on päris
raske töö! Kaevamine
nõuab palju lihasjõudu.
{07 14 00}Aga just see teeb avastuse
seda magusamaks,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Wow, I thought finding a
fossil would be easier than
this{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 0f 00}Maybe I'm just not cut out
to be a paleontologist,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Vau, ma arvasin, et fossiili
leidmine on lihtsam kui
see{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 0f 00}Ehk ma lihtsalt ei sobi
paleontoloogiks,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Huh.{01 00 00 0f 00} This fossil-hunting
business is a lot harder
than I expected.
{07 06 00}Even finding a little tiny
one would make me feel so
much better{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ah.{01 00 00 0f 00} See fossiilijaht on
palju raskem, kui ma
ootasin.
{07 06 00}Isegi ühe pisikese leidmine
paneks mind palju paremini
tundma{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.{01 00 00 03 00}.
